reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Moore CPA ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance report as of 27 July 2026 04:30:30 PM HKT (PDF via widget.verinumus.io/api/v1/tusd/report; PDF CreationDate 2026-07-27) lists Total TrueUSD tokens issued 494,515,082.75 and USD denominated collateral of US Treasury Bills $0, First Digital Trust Limited $501,850,000, and US Dollars Cash $78,900.88, totaling US$501,928,900.88 (FDT 99.98% and cash 0.02% of that total at reported cost). The same-system live snapshot (widget.verinumus.io/api/v1/tusd/snapshot, timestamp 2026-07-27T08:30:48.069Z) independently returns totalToken 494515082.75 and totalTrust 501928900.88 with no per-line composition rows. tusd.io/transparency embeds the Verinumus widget and states daily Moore Hong Kong attestations with reserve breakdown. Live classification therefore remains one 100% aggregate USD-reserves row keyed to the attested total; report-level FDT/cash detail is recorded in knownUnknownExposure and custodyProfile but cannot be split one-to-one against the live feed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Moore CPA examination of the TUSD Consolidated Reserves Report as of July 27, 2026, corroborated by Verinumus live snapshot totals and the issuer transparency embed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live snapshot exposes only aggregate totalTrust. Moore's report identifies a 99.98% First Digital Trust fund/other-instruments position reported at cost (fair value not examined) and 0.02% cash at Bahamian depository institutions; fund underlying assets, liquidity, counterparties, and current fair value remain undisclosed. The report notes ongoing Techteryx litigation against FDT, DIFC freezing orders up to US$456 million, and that substantially all Hong Kong depository collateral was invested for yield and is not readily convertible to cash.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The exact live identity is a single aggregate totalTrust row. Report-level 99.98% opaque FDT fund/other instruments plus 0.02% cash cannot support a one-to-one tracked dependency or a more granular live classification, even though the report-level split is recorded in this review and custody profile.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Moore Note 2 states USD collateral is held at a Hong Kong depository (First Digital Trust Limited) and Bahamian depository institutions for the benefit of TrueUSD token holders; FDT has invested all or substantially all of that collateral in other instruments at cost, with ongoing litigation over redemption. Bahamian institutions are not named. The report does not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness. Issuer transparency corroborates Moore as the daily attestor but does not restate custodian share percentages.
